questions.question: Where must you stop on red when there is an ASL bike box?
options: Behind the first white stop line
Ahead of the second white line
questions.explanation: Leave the ASL box clear so cyclists have a safe space ahead.

questions.question: What should you do if a cyclist is beside you going ahead?
options: Wait and let the cyclist pass first
Turn quickly in front of them
Sound your horn to warn them
questions.explanation: Never cut across cyclists going ahead when you turn.
